Shulk. How are you holding up?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I'm fine.[XENO:n ]
But...you...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
I will shed no tears.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Huh?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]A year ago, I felt the same sense[XENO:n ]
of deep loss that I do now.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]The Battle of Sword Valley.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
After that battle, many of my friends did not make it home.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

While I was being brought here on that stretcher,[XENO:n ]
they were all I thought about.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:jaw jaw=off ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ][XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:jaw jaw=on ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]But I decided I would not cry.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Everyone who died in that war had[XENO:n ]
something they wanted to protect.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Family, friends, loved ones, their home...[XENO:n ]
So they fought to protect them.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
And we won.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]No matter how painful, no matter how hard,[XENO:n ]
it's nothing to be sad about...[XENO:wait wait=key ]
I decided that there and then.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Dunban-san![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Shulk, Fiorung would tell you the same thing.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:jaw jaw=off ][XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:jaw jaw=on ][XENO:del del=this ]

She wanted to protect us. Or rather, she wanted[XENO:n ]
to protect you. And you're alive now.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
So I will not cry.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]OK.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Remember the gift of life that Fiorung[XENO:n ]
gave you, and treasure it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I...I can't say that I understand.[XENO:n ]
But...I hope to, some day.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]That is all I ask. Believe me, I am[XENO:n ]
